info.name: YNAB API — QA
info.description:
QA collection for the YNAB API as consumed by ynab-mcp.

Generated from:
  - tests/qa/features/*.feature  (human-readable scenarios)
  - tests/qa/cases/*.yaml        (executable case definitions)
  - tests/fixtures/*.json        (request body fixtures)

Total cases: 31

DO NOT hand-edit this file. Edit the source files and regenerate:
  uv run python scripts/generate_qa_collection.py

Run with Newman:
  newman run postman/collections/ynab-qa.postman_collection.json \
    --environment postman/environments/ynab-qa.postman_environment.json \
    --folder 'Auth And Plans'

CI smoke check (read-only cases):
  newman run ... --folder 'Auth And Plans' --folder 'Transactions Read'

item.name: [QA-ERR-004] POST transaction with missing required field returns 422

request.description:
**Case:** QA-ERR-004

**Intent:** POST transaction with missing required field returns 422

**Notes:** YNAB returns 400 (not 422) for validation errors on malformed request bodies.
The YnabMcpError.from_ynab_response mapping treats both 400 and 422 as
YNAB_API_ERROR — this test confirms the actual status code used by the API.


**Expected status:** 400

**Source:** 04_error_handling.yaml

request.description:
**Case:** QA-ERR-005

**Intent:** Error response data.error.id is always a string

**Notes:** YnabMcpError.from_ynab_response reads error_id as a string.
If YNAB ever changes this to an integer, the model must be updated.


**Expected status:** 404

**Source:** 04_error_handling.yaml
